author: GretchenMarina
text: We need FAccT/Ethical AI work on the risks raised by AI capabilities as well as limitations. Those working against dangerous powerful AI can and need to work together. (I’m hesitant to adopt “pushing snake oil” framing, but deeply appreciate @KLdivergence work and this message!)

quoted.text: There’s one existential risk I’m certain LLMs pose and that’s to the credibility of the field of FAccT / Ethical AI if we keep pushing the snake oil narrative about them.
